# Test fixtures

Every address in this directory is **synthetic**. The `0xc0ffee…` contract
addresses are placeholders chosen to be obviously fake; they are not the
addresses of any real token, and nothing in V0A resolves them against a chain.

`krakmask_ink_buy.policy.json` is named for KRAKMASK because KRAKMASK is the
intended *user-selected* Ink fixture once the V0B Ink shadow adapter exists.
The file is a schema exercise. It is not an endorsement, a safety claim, a
recommendation, or an assertion that the named token is legitimate or
tradeable. The chain id `57073` is Ink mainnet.
